mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (receiver_id, sender_id, notification_type, content, related_id, related_url, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{receiverId}, #{senderId}, #{notificationType}, #{content}, #{relatedId}, #{relatedUrl}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT n.notification_id AS notificationId, n.receiver_id AS receiverId, n.sender_id AS senderId, n.notification_type AS notificationType, n.content AS content, n.related_id AS relatedId, n.related_url AS relatedUrl, n.is_read AS isRead, n.created_at AS createdAt,
-- 보낸 사람 정보 (JOIN) u.user_name AS senderName, u.profile_image AS senderProfileImage FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN users u ON n.sender_id = u.user_id WHERE n.receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notifications WHERE is_read = 1 AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
